articleTitle: Why You Can't Eat Around Your Partner Without Feeling Sick
imageHeadline: Why Eating With Your Partner Makes You Nauseous
imageSubtext: It's not the relationship—it's social anxiety around food. Here's what helps.
pinTitle: Nausea When Eating With Your Partner? Understanding Social Eating Anxiety
pinDescription: Feeling sick or unable to eat around a new partner isn't a red flag about the relationship. It's a common form of social anxiety tied to eating in front of others. Understand what's happening and find practical, evidence-based ways to ease the discomfort and enjoy meals together.
